ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Recon Activity Via Nltest.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects nltest commands that can be used for information discovery

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "nltestrk\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*server.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*query.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/user.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*all\\_trusts.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dclist\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dnsgetdc\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*domain\\_trusts.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dsgetdc\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*parentdomain.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*trusted\\_domains.*"))))
